quotes.text: Nature isn’t classical, dammit, and if you want to make a simulation of nature, you’d better make it quantum mechanical.
quotes.author: Richard Feynman

quotes.text: What I cannot create, I do not understand.
quotes.author: Richard Feynman

quotes.text: Computers are incredibly fast, accurate, and stupid. Humans are incredibly slow, inaccurate, and brilliant. Together they are powerful beyond imagination.
quotes.author: John Pfeiffer

quotes.text: The whole is something besides the parts.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.text: The reductionist approach has failed in complex systems. The next revolution in physics will be about emergence.
quotes.author: Philip Anderson

quotes.text: In physics, you don't have to go around making trouble for yourself — nature does it for you.
quotes.author: Frank Wilczek

quotes.text: There’s plenty of room at the bottom.
quotes.author: Richard Feynman

quotes.text: It is only slightly overstating the case to say that physics is the study of symmetry.
quotes.author: P. W. Anderson

quotes.text: In condensed matter physics, you see beautiful emergence that is not obvious from the underlying equations.
quotes.author: Subir Sachdev

quotes.text: The great thing about computer simulations is that they do exactly what you tell them to do. The bad thing is — they do exactly what you tell them to do.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The best material model of a cat is another, or preferably the same, cat.
quotes.author: Norbert Wiener

quotes.text: The real voyage of discovery consists not in seeking new landscapes, but in having new eyes.
quotes.author: Marcel Proust

quotes.text: Quantum mechanics is not about the reality of particles, but about the information we can obtain about them.
quotes.author: Anton Zeilinger
